questions_and_answers.question: Although the power of taxation is basically legislative in character, it is NOT the function of Congress to: (2011 Bar Question) A) fix with certainty the amount of taxes. B) collect the tax levied under the law. C) identify who should collect the tax. D) determine who should be subject to the tax.

Although the power of taxation is basically legislative in character, it is not the function of the Congress to 1 point fix with certainty the amount of taxes collect the tax levied under the law determine who should be subject to the tax identify who should collect the tax
questions_and_answers.answer: Answer The power of taxation is primarily legislative, but it is not the function of the Congress to fix with certainty the amount of taxes. Instead, this responsibility falls under the executive branch. The Congress is responsible for enacting tax laws, while the executive branch, through the relevant agencies, is tasked with collecting the tax levied under the law and determining who should be subject to the tax.
